name: Why is local SEO different for dentists compared to other businesses?

mainEntity.name: Why is local SEO different for dentists compared to other businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local SEO for dentists is distinct because patient acquisition is heavily driven by proximity and trust within a specific community. Unlike e-commerce or services that can operate globally, dental practices rely almost entirely on patients living or working nearby. This means a strong emphasis on Google My Business reviews, local citations, and geo-targeted content. Patients often seek emergency care or convenience, making local search ranking even more critical than for businesses with broader service areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local SEO for dentists prioritizes proximity and community trust, with a strong focus on GMB reviews and geo-targeted content due to the local nature of patient acquisition.
